title: Guided SSO connector negotiation and schema assertion validator
creator: Aria Patel
description: Implement a guided SAML 2.0 connector negotiation flow in the SSO setup wizard focused on robust metadata exchange and schema assertion validation. The wizard should: 1) support automatic metadata fetch with a manual upload fallback, 2) perform schema and assertion validation including: entityID normalization, singleLogout binding checks, AssertionConsumerService URL verification, signing certificate chain validation (including trust anchor heuristics), and clock-skew tolerant signature verification, 3) surface actionable, non-technical error messages and remediation steps for admins, 4) emit structured audit events for every step (attempt, success, failure, fallback), and 5) be gated to admin users with RBAC v2 checks and include a canary rollout flag. Non-goals: federation cataloging and IdP discovery beyond metadata URL and uploaded XML.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard can fetch metadata from a provided URL and parse it into internal schema without throwing uncaught exceptions
When metadata contains multiple AssertionConsumerService endpoints, wizard prompts admin to choose and validates reachability
Signature validation accepts certificates when the chain leads to a configured trust anchor or when the admin explicitly pins a certificate fingerprint
Time skew up to 5 minutes tolerated for signed assertions and documented in UI; larger skew surfaces clear remediation guidance
All wizard steps (fetch, parse, validate, confirm) generate audit log entries with user, timestamp, action, result, and metadata fingerprint
Non-admin users cannot access the wizard; attempts are logged and return an explanatory RBAC error
End-to-end E2E tests cover remote metadata fetch with mocked HTTP, manual upload parsing, and signature validation failure modes
Feature flag exists for canary rollout and telemetry shows adoption for first 10% of orgs
updates: 2026-02-25: Spike complete — verified Python xmlsec bindings and existing cert path validation libs. Chose node-gost or xml-crypto? Decided on xmlsec via native shim for deterministic signature verification.

2026-03-02: Prototype wizard UI built; metadata fetch implemented with retry/backoff and content-type validation. Observed some IdPs returning text/xml vs application/xml — added heuristic to accept both.
2026-03-08: Security review pre-check: raised requirement to record certificate fingerprint + serialized issuer in audit logs. Also agreed to present a 'pin certificate' option for admin override.

2026-03-12: Integration tests failing intermittently for chained certs in test harness. Added a mocked trust anchor store to isolate failure; root cause appears to be ordering of certs in metadata (leaf-first vs root-first) — handling updated to re-order into chain before validation.
comments: Samir (SecEng): Please ensure the wizard records the full metadata XML in encrypted audit storage for later forensic analysis.
Lina (PM): For UX, when multiple ACS endpoints exist, prefer preselecting the https-POST binding but allow manual override for advanced users.
Marco (Assignee): Will add telemetry event 'sso.saml_wizard.step.{step}.result' and map to console-2026.03 release for feature flagging.
audit_log_changes: sso.saml_wizard.validation — signature_ok, cert_fingerprint, trust_anchor_used, clock_skew_seconds, result
test_plan: Unit tests for parser and validation helpers. Integration tests: remote metadata fetch with mocked IdP endpoints (200, 301, 503), upload XML edge cases (missing entityID, multiple certs, invalid signatures), and RBAC enforcement tests. Add smoke E2E under canary flag to verify UI flows and audit logs. Automated nightly regression for signature verification against a small matrix of cert chains.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge behind feature flag, deploy to staging. 2) Canary: enable for 10% orgs for 48h with extra telemetry. 3) Monitor audit logs for failures, latency, and false-positive signature rejects. 4) Expand to 50% then 100% if stability criteria met. 5) Post-launch: 1-week review and address top 3 support issues.
notes: Follow-ups: add admin-facing 'simulate assertion' tool for debugging, document interoperability notes for common IdPs (Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin), and schedule a runbook for common failure patterns. Coordinate with Compliance to ensure stored metadata retention window meets policy.
